Scores a single post, blog draft or email for AI slop on a 1-10 scale, quotes each offending phrase with a plain rewrite, and returns pass or revise against your threshold. Delivered as a downloadable Markdown report.

AI Slop Check is a single-purpose utility that judges one piece of writing for AI slop. A score of 10 means the text reads as written by a specific person.

What you give it: the text to check (required, up to 50,000 characters), a pass threshold from 1 to 10 (optional, defaults to 7), and a voice profile (optional) so the text is also checked against the author's own voice.

What you get back: a 1-10 slop score and a pass or revise verdict, each offending span quoted with the pattern named and a plain rewrite suggested, and the full report as a downloadable Markdown file.

The agent only suggests fixes for the flagged spans and never rewrites the whole piece. It does no web search, and nothing is posted or sent anywhere. Your text is treated as material to judge, not as instructions.
